query_text: which came first the walking dead comic or show

message.content:
Based on the search results, **The Walking Dead comic came first**.

The comic book series was first published on **October 8, 2003** by Image Comics, created by Robert Kirkman and Tony Moore. The TV show premiered much later on **October 31, 2010** on AMC, developed by Frank Darabont and based on the comic book series. The comic ran for 193 issues from 2003 to 2019, while the TV series ran for 11 seasons from 2010 to 2022.
